business_summary: Xinjiang Talimu Agriculture Development Co., Ltd. produces and sells various agricultural products in China and internationally. The company offers propagation base products, seeds, cotton seeds, wheat seeds, fattening cattle, licorice, forage, and other agricultural products, as well as rice-by products. It is also involved in the beef cattle breeding and farming businesses. It sells its seeds products through its own distribution system and sales agency; and its beef products to middlemen, retailers, and end consumers through wholesale markets, supermarkets and restaurants. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Aral, China.
